items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Larry Shields? [INTERVIEWEE] No. My impression of the white musician in New Orleans at that time was so low that I wouldn't walk two steps to hear a white musician.

ctx.x: yeah most likely and this kid was playing clarinet and I wonder who he was how old was he? could have been Larry no no I think he was younger than I was at that time this kid and that's the reason I felt sure that I could play a wind instrument when I saw this kid and instead of going crazy for the clarinet when I saw him on clarinet I went crazy for the cornet
you started to tell a minute ago about your first instruments when you started what did you start
